name: forge
description: Continuous engineering loop for Claude Code: Jev-based size/clarity triage, a plan-clarify-build-test-revise harness for small tasks, and for large tasks goal+spec from Jira/Docs/PDF/PRD/Figma, codebase scope validation, detailed clarify (incl. subagent count without file collisions), spec lock, an autoresearch-style ratchet loop with an orchestrator, worktree lanes and a deterministic judge (happy/unhappy/edge/regression), BLOCKED findings, final report, and per-repo self-learning.

jevLanes.title: Jev lanes (order)
jevLanes.description: Comma-separated failover order of Jev backends: zen (opencode, keyless), commandcode (200/day), typesafe, openrouter

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.title: TypeSafe API key
TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: Only for the typesafe lane (calibrated confidence)

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.title: OpenRouter API key
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Only for the openrouter lane (alpha decisions API)

jevTimeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: Per-lane latency budget; on timeout the next lane is tried, then forge falls back deterministically

autoTriage.title: Triage every prompt
autoTriage.description: Classify engineering prompts as clarify / small / large on submit

reportCmd.title: Report command
reportCmd.description: Shell command used by the 'command' report target; receives FORGE_REPORT_PATH and FORGE_REPORT_SUBJECT

extraInstincts.title: Extra instinct store
extraInstincts.description: Optional read-only directory of <repo>/*.yaml instincts merged into prompts

maxWorkers.title: Max parallel subagents
maxWorkers.description: Hard cap on loop lanes (the recommendation also respects free RAM and Jev quota)

smallMaxRevisions.title: Small task: max revisions
smallMaxRevisions.description: Red test runs before the small harness escalates to you

routeAgents.title: Route loop agents
routeAgents.description: Pick model + effort per loop lane/orchestrator with Jev (each is a fresh claude -p, no cache loss)

fastModel.title: Fast tier model
fastModel.description: Model for mechanical slices (first ladder rung)

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier model
balancedModel.description: Model for ordinary slices and the second ladder rung (default tier)

deepModel.title: Deep tier model
deepModel.description: Model for hard/risky slices and the top ladder rung

maxEffort.title: Highest effort
maxEffort.description: Routing never goes above this: low, medium, high, xhigh

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend more
minUpgradeConfidence.description: Jev confidence needed to raise tier/effort

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend less
minDowngradeConfidence.description: Jev confidence needed to lower tier/effort

jevDecide.title: Jev pre-decides findings
jevDecide.description: Reject a finding without an LLM call when Jev maps it to a spec exclusion line with high confidence

jevRejectBar.title: Jev reject confidence
jevRejectBar.description: Confidence needed for Jev to reject a finding on its own

jevCompaction.title: Jev compaction
jevCompaction.description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction in interactive sessions (function hooks only)

compactAtPercent.title: Auto-compact at %
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage that triggers a compaction (function hooks only)

minReductionRatio.title: Min compaction reduction
minReductionRatio.description: Below this, the built-in summary is used instead

routeSessionSubagents.title: Route session subagents
routeSessionSubagents.description: Pick the model of Agent-tool subagents in interactive sessions (function hooks only)

ladderFailsFast.title: Ladder: fails on fast
ladderFailsFast.description: Gate failures on the fast tier before the item moves up (haiku -> sonnet)

ladderFailsBalanced.title: Ladder: fails on balanced
ladderFailsBalanced.description: Gate failures on the balanced tier before the item moves up (sonnet -> opus)

ladderFailsDeep.title: Ladder: fails on deep
ladderFailsDeep.description: Gate failures on the deep tier before the item is BLOCKED for you
